relevance_note: Case series of 16 LAMP2-confirmed patients with individual rows in Table 1 ('we identified 16 patients with Danon disease, including 13 previously identified cases').
method_note: Read the whole paper; a Python script (scratch dir) transcribed Table 1 and Table 2 cells and built the rows; I checked the transcribed values against both tables. Labels: Table 1's first column numbers the 16 patients and the text refers to them as "patient <n>" / "No. <n> in Table 1", so rule 1 gives "patient 1" ... "patient 16" (label span = Table 1 row through Age/Gender). Table 2 rows use the same numbers; the unlabeled row after patient 4 holds patient 4's post-ablation values (legend: "These values of patient 4 were measured before and after ablation") and was not used. Table 1 "Age (years)" is recorded as age at diagnosis, supported by the text "aged between 0.25 and 43 years (median 16.5 years) at diagnosis" (the table range matches). Table 1 cells such as "19/24/41/61" are column-defined (IVS/LVPW/LV size/LVEF), not stacked per-patient cells, so they were read by the header. Reduced LVEF (patients 3, 4, 5, 12, 14) and dilated LV cavity (4, 5, 12, 14) were assigned by matching table values to the text ranges (22-46%; 53-65 mm), which select exactly five and four patients; LVOT obstruction (2, 6, 7, 9) by non-zero gradient matching "present at rest in 4 patients (gradient, 11-50 mmHg)". Zero LVOT gradients were not recorded as excluded obstruction. Short PR (<120 ms per the text) was assigned from Table 2 PR values (9 patients, matching the text count) and used for the pre-excitation checklist item. Table 1's legend defines "-" as negative: used for arrhythmias "-", serum enzymes "-" and death "-" (alive). Per D-27, "-" in the Arrhythmias and Serum-enzymes columns excludes only "arrhythmias" / "elevated serum enzymes", not AV block, SVT, VT/VF, CK or transaminases; "+" serum enzymes ("creatine kinase, liver transaminase and/or lactate dehydrogenase") was not mapped to elevated CK or liver enzymes. Table 2 has no legend defining "-", so VP "-" and nQRS "-" were left not reported. Table 2 HR, QRS width, voltage and QTc values were not turned into features. Patient 3's FVP comes from Table 2 EP values plus "Four patients who underwent electrophysiological studies all had FVPs" (inferred from group statement). The mother of patients 14 and 15 ("asymptomatic", "no ECG and echocardiographic abnormality") gets whole-investigation exclusions only. Relatives in scope: mothers of patients 1 and 5 (likely carriers, died of heart failure), mother of patient 8 (same LAMP2 mutation), mother of patients 14 and 15 (genetically affected; no variant row because the paper does not say she carries the same or any printed variant), and the tested-negative parents of patients 4, 6, 7 and 16 (two each, sex not stated). Mothers of patients 2 and 3 (untested, no symptoms) are out of scope. Variant type not recorded: the text gives only a list ("Eight frameshift mutations, 7 non-sense mutations and 1 splicing mutation") for the group. Families: 12 families stated, but no family labels; shared variants (patients 9-11, 12-13) do not establish stated relationships. Contradictions noted: the Discussion says "2 patients developed AV conduction block and another had decreased AV node conduction with an effective refractory period of 440 ms", but Table 2's AVNERP 440 ms is in patient 4's post-ablation row and patient 4 is also listed with AVB; not used. The Results text on patient 5's echo is split across sections ("contrast in" / "the right ventricular apex"), so only the first part is quoted.
